parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of ABS plastic, forming the main upper structure that users press to staple papers.
parts.Functional_description: It transmits the pressing force to the internal mechanism that drives the staple through the paper.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates downward around a hinge when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler, made of ABS plastic, covers the staple magazine and provides access for reloading staples.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal staple magazine and can be lifted to insert new staples.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots upward around a hinge to allow staple refilling and closes securely during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler is made of steel, providing structural support and stability during stapling.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the anvil plate that bends the staple legs and provides a stable surface for paper alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the foundation for the stapler’s moving parts.
